description.en:
The name of the Logstore group.

For information about how to obtain the name of a Logstore group, see [DescribeHybridMonitorSLSGroup](~~429526~~).

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，删除Logstore组`Logstore_test`。返回结果显示，删除Logstore组成功。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to delete a Logstore group named `Logstore_test`. The response shows that the Logstore group is deleted.
